issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 317 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: No large spidery pieces
issues.message: This is a large part made of thin, spread-out arms (average thickness about 0.65 mm, fills 9% of its outline). Parts like this warp, break and are hard to ship.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the arms, add connecting webs, or split it into sturdier pieces.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: No large spidery pieces
issues.message: This large part is thin on average (about 1.87 mm). It may flex or warp.
issues.suggestion: Add ribs or thicken the thinnest sections.
